title: `new_websocket_client` cyclomatic complexity 22 (87 lines)
detail: `new_websocket_client` (lines 167–285) has CCN=22 across 87 lines. Each additional branch multiplies test cases needed for full coverage. Fix: extract one or more decision-heavy sub-routines.

title: Line 125: inconsistent return statements — some paths return a value, some don't
detail: The function at/near line 125 has paths that return a value and paths that fall off the end (implicit `return None`). Callers expecting a return value silently receive `None` on the implicit path. Fix: add explicit `return None` or ensure all paths return a consistent type.

title: too-many-branches (R0912) — function(s) at line 167
detail: A function has more branches than pylint's threshold. High branch count multiplies test cases needed for coverage and makes the function a defect magnet. Fix: extract decision clusters into named helper functions.
